posts.text:
Knowing when to stop is hard for language models controlling a robot arm

➤ Claude Opus 5.5 completed the task in 23 minutes, and said so: "The crocodile looks fully inside now"

➤ It then spent 22 minutes pushing the crocodile back and forth, only to finish almost exactly where it was before

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.name: Artificial Analysis
posts.text: This wasn’t unique to Claude Opus 5.5, with only GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon stopping within a minute of completing the task. GPT-6 Astra submitted 3 minutes after the passing state, Claude Fable 5.1 kept going for 7 minutes, and Claude Opus 5.5 for a full 22 minutes
